name: av_bbands
description:
Bollinger Bands (Alpha Vantage BBANDS) for one stock, computed on closing prices.
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Technical Analysis: BBANDS"} keyed by date or timestamp, each with Real Upper Band, Real Middle Band, Real Lower Band.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker); interval (1min to 60min, daily, weekly or monthly; default daily); time_period (bars in the window, 2-500; default 20).
Use it for volatility bands around a moving average (Alpha Vantage's default 2 standard deviations); av_atr for a single volatility number. Raw prices: av_stock_daily.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM", "interval": "daily", "time_period": 20}

interval.description: Bar interval: 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly or monthly

time_period.description: Number of bars in the indicator window
